scripts.dev: bash -lc 'set -a; [ -f apps/lexidraw/.env.local ] && source apps/lexidraw/.env.local; [ -f .env.development ] && source .env.development; set +a; conda run -n kokoro311 uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8010 --reload --app-dir apps/kokoro-service >> apps/kokoro-service/uvicorn.log 2>&1 &' && bun dotenv -e .env.development -- turbo run dev --parallel --filter=@apps/lexidraw --filter=@apps/render-html-worker --filter=@apps/cron-runner
scripts.clean: turbo run clean && rm -rf node_modules && rm -f bun.lockb && rm -rf .turbo
scripts.cli:install: bun run --filter @apps/cli compile && mkdir -p "$HOME/.ai/bin" && install -m 755 apps/cli/dist/lexidraw "$HOME/.ai/bin/lexidraw"
